dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Able to understand cause and effect
activities: Play board games that involve strategy
Work on puzzles appropriate for their age

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Uses a wider vocabulary in conversation
Can write short stories or reports
activities: Encourage daily reading and discussing books
Play word games or vocabulary-building games

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Can ride a bike with confidence
Can perform more complex physical activities (e.g., dance, sports)
activities: Encourage participation in team sports or physical activities
Engage in arts and crafts that require fine motor skills
watchFor: Difficulty in physical coordination compared to peers
Frequent complaints of discomfort while moving

dimensions.title: Social
milestones: Shows understanding of shared rules in games
watchFor: Struggles to make or maintain friendships
Shows lack of interest in cooperative play

dimensions.title: Emotional
activities: Practice mindfulness or relaxation exercises together
watchFor: Difficulty calming down after being upset

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Asks more complex questions about the world
Shows interest in learning new things
activities: Provide kits for science experiments or crafts
watchFor: Lack of questions or disinterest in new experiences
Shows little motivation to explore or learn

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on tasks for longer periods
Uses a variety of strategies to learn new material
activities: Use educational apps or games that promote focus

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can complete some daily tasks without help
activities: Encourage them to manage their own time
Provide opportunities for decision-making in daily activities
watchFor: Relying excessively on adults for help
